collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager checks the length of a stick's shadow to see how late it is.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) checks the length of a stick's shadow to see how late it is. It is later than (name1) thought, and (name1) hurries off.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) checks the length of a stick's shadow to see how late it is. It is earlier than (name1) thought, and (name1) sits back down to rest.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) checks the length of a stick's shadow to see how late it is. A child asks how it works, and (name1) explains while drawing in the sand.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) checks the length of a stick's shadow to see how late it is. A cloud covers the sun, and the shadow vanishes entirely.

text_only.reason: the word's everyday sense (a thing or a sound gone); nobody leaves the village -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)
